Well made (sturdy) overall but the cutting blades are not sharp enough to do the job. When clipping i can feel a pulling effect (upon seperation) on the whole toe nail. Worse, one have to apply exorbitant squeeze force and doing so cutting is abrupt and creates pain on toe. All in all, this is not a flimsy clipper, but it's functionality is bad. Perhaps a design flaw with the angle of its two shear-cutting blades? 5 stars for the material and sturdiness, zero star for its intended purpose.

reviews.t: Perfect Nipper for Nails at Home
reviews.x: This nipper is heavy duty! It's large and perfect if you have bigger hands. I like that it's the one that automatically spring open. The other ones that don't can make your hands feel so fatigued. Great quality hardware also used. I am planning on doing my own manicures now as shops cost and arm and a leg. This is a great took to get started doing that. The tips are very sharp, but it comes with a plastic covering that helps in case you poke yourself on accident looking for it in your tool bag.

reviews.t: Sturdy, Strong and better than I expected
reviews.x: These are stronger and more sturdy than any others I've seen in stores.  They do not feel flimsy or cheep and I can tell it's built to last.  The others I've had before had weak inner springs that made them hard to use precisely.  I used these tonight to do a manicure on my two daughters, ages 8 and 10, and it was easy to manage these even on their tiny fingers.  I'm so grateful I found these and had the chance to review them.  They are totally worth it!!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the clippers sharp and effective for ingrown toenails and general nail trimming.
A common complaint is that the blades are not sharp enough, requiring excessive pressure and causing pulling or tearing.
Reviewers praise the sturdy, strong construction and solid feel compared to traditional clippers.
Some users report durability issues, including dulling over time and rust on the hinge.
The pointed, straight tip design is appreciated for reaching hard places and avoiding jagged or curved cuts.
